subject: RIDDOR deadline in {daysLeft} — {referenceNumber}
preheader: A reportable incident on {productName} has not been submitted to the HSE yet.
body:
The incident {referenceNumber} was screened as RIDDOR-reportable ({categoryLabel}) and has not yet been submitted to the HSE.

Statutory deadline: {deadlineAt} UTC ({daysLeft} remaining).

Submit the report via the HSE online form (or by phone for fatal and specified injuries), then record the submission on the incident so the clock stops.
footer: You are receiving this because you own this incident or hold incident management permissions in {productName}.
